snippet.title: Golden Retriever Simple Life - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4096810/Golden_Retriever_Simple_Life/

Share your days with an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Feed, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day. Teach tricks, discover new walks locations, and keep your furry friend happy and healthy.
